title: Pullback and coefficient comparisons
statement: Let $V$ be a nonempty connected scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\ell$ a prime, $P$ a finite group and $c:Y\to V$ a finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(P)$-torsor with nonempty connected total space [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Put $k=\mathbf F_\ell$ and $\widetilde k=\operatorname{ULift}(k)$.For the associated module functor $T_c$ [def-weil-pbc-torsor-associated-module], there is a natural isomorphism $c^*T_c\cong S\circ\operatorname{forget}$ followed by the constant sheaf functor on $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], where $S$ restricts scalars along $\widetilde k\to k$. Also $T_c$ of the trivial representation on $\operatorname{ULift}(k)$ is isomorphic to the constant coefficient sheaf on $V$.

proof.text: Compute etale pullback by upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction. Use pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility for the continuous and cocontinuous localization functor to move sheafification past restriction. Whisker the diagonal presheaf comparison with presheafToSheaf, then compose with sheafificationNatIso to obtain the natural pullback comparison. No separate sheaf axiom for the equivariant presheaf is needed.

Map the invariant coefficient presheaf comparison through presheafToSheaf. Compose with the inverse sheafificationIso of the constant coefficient sheaf. Return the two composed isomorphisms as Nonempty witnesses.

theorem Scheme.GaloisCover.associatedModuleFunctor_comparisons
    {V : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace V] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (P : Type u) [Group P] [Finite P]
    (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} P) V) [ConnectedSpace c.P] :
    let C := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))
    let T := c.associatedModuleFunctor ℓ
    Nonempty (T ⋙ (c.π)^*[C] ≅
      forget₂ (Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1}
          (ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) →+* ZMod ℓ) ⋙
        constantSheaf c.P.smallEtaleTopology C) ∧
    Nonempty (T.obj (Rep.trivial (ZMod ℓ) P (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))) ≅
      (constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology C).obj
        (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
